name: Dr. Anu V R
bio:
Dr Anu Raveendran is an Deputy Dean, Computer Science and Engineering at JAIN (Deemed-to-be University). A distinguished academic with a PhD in Cloud Computing, she brings extensive teaching experience in Computer Science and Engineering.

Her expertise spans AI, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning, with research interests in the effects of meditation on brain waves and dementia studies. Leveraging her unique background as a psychologist, Dr Anu adopts a holistic approach to education, tailoring her teaching methods to individual learning needs. She is also an active participant in academic events and knowledge-sharing initiatives.

name: Dr. Deepak Kumar Sinha
bio:
Dr. Deepak K. Sinha, Deputy Director, Professor and PG Head (CSE & Cyber Security) at JAIN (Deemed-to-be University), possesses a strong professional background and exceptional leadership skills in the field. With in-depth knowledge of Computer Science and related disciplines, he has developed effective teaching strategies and delivered engaging presentations to students and corporate clients.

Having accumulated over 20 years of experience in teaching and research, Dr. Sinha has made notable contributions to the academic community. He played a crucial role in a UNDP project focused on Ethiopian Universities, dedicating more than 6 years to this endeavor.

Dr. Sinha holds degrees at various levels of education in Computer Science, including UG, PG, and Ph.D. Currently, he completed his PGD in AI/ML from NIT, Warangal.

name: Dr. Kamlesh Tiwari
bio:
Dr. Kamlesh Tiwari is Professor and Head of the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at JAIN (Deemed-to-be University). He earned his Ph.D. from the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at the Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur. His research interests span machine learning, deep learning, artificial intelligence, computer vision, and multimodal biometrics, with a particular focus on modalities such as fingerprint, face, palmprint, knuckleprint, forehead crease, teeth photo, and footprint recognition.

An accomplished researcher, Dr. Tiwari has authored over 80 publications across reputed journals, conferences, and edited volumes. He is actively engaged in organising workshops and academic forums in the areas of machine learning and deep learning. A member of the IEEE and the Signal Processing Society, he contributes to both academic scholarship and applied research. He is also the Co-Founder of CogniX Technologies, a research-led enterprise developing innovative solutions in motion analysis, including tracking, detection, and feature matching.

name: Dr. Mahesh T R
bio:
Dr. Mahesh T R is an Professor at the Faculty of Engineering and Technology, JAIN (Deemed-to-be University). He holds a BE, MTech, and Ph.D. in Computer Science and Engineering and is recognized for his exceptional teaching methods that promote creative and critical thinking.

With a prolific output of over 150 research papers in renowned Scopus/WoS and SCIE indexed journals, Dr. Mahesh has established a distinguished research record. He has edited books on emerging technologies for esteemed publishers such as IEEE, Springer, IGI Global, and Wiley.

In addition, he has served as a guest editor for special issues in reputable journals, including the International Journal of Intelligent Computing and Cybernetics, International Journal of e-Collaboration (IJeC), International Journal of Pervasive Computing and Communications (IJPCC), International Journal of System of Systems Engineering (IJSSE), International Journal of Autonomous Intelligence, International Journal of Machine Learning and Computing (IJMLC), International Journal of Cloud Computing (IJCC), and International Journal of Information Quality (IJIQ).

Dr. Mahesh is highly respected in the academic community, contributing as a reviewer, technical committee member, and guest editor for esteemed journals and conferences. His research interests include image processing, machine learning, deep learning, AI, IoT, and data science, where he has made significant contributions.

name: Dr P.Thiruvannamalai Sivasankar
bio:
Dr. P. Thiruvannamalai Sivasankar is a Professor of Computer Science and Business Systems at JAIN (Deemed-to-be University). He completed his PhD in Computer Science and Engineering from the Sathyabama Institute of Science and Technology. Chennai With over 24 years of teaching experience and 3 years of industry experience, he brings a wealth of knowledge to his role.

Dr. Sivasankar has authored over 27 papers published in reputable indexed journals. His research interests include network security, information security, and machine learning.

Known for fostering innovation, Dr. Sivasankar encourages students to implement creative ideas in their project work. He actively organises international and national conferences, seminars, and workshops.

Dr. Sivasankar is a life member of the Indian Society for Technical Education (ISTE), demonstrating his commitment to professional development and collaboration within the academic community.

name: Dr.B.Swaminathan
bio:
"Dr. B. Swaminathan, a distinguished Professor at JAIN (Deemed-to-be University) School of Computer Science and Engineering, specializes in Cloud Computing, Deep Learning, IoT, and Data Analytics. His research focuses on multi-attribute decision-making mechanisms for peer selection in collaborative peer-to-peer systems, with extensive publications showcasing his expertise.

He holds a Ph.D. in Information and Communication Engineering from Anna University, Chennai, and Master's and Bachelor's degrees in Computer Science & Engineering and Electronics and Communication Engineering, respectively.

Dr. Swaminathan actively contributes to the academic community as a member and treasurer (2021-2023) of the Computer Society of India's Chennai chapter."

name: Dr.Garima sinha
bio:
"Dr Garima is a dynamic and dedicated professional with extensive experience in academia and industry, specializing in Computer Science and related fields. Demonstrates exceptional leadership qualities and expertise in preparing and delivering engaging lectures, facilitating classroom discussions, and designing comprehensive lesson plans tailored to meet the diverse learning needs of students. She is having 25 years of National and International teaching learning and research experience. She worked as Alumni Director also.

A visionary educator and researcher with a proven track record of excellence in academia, dedicated to empowering students with cutting-edge knowledge and skills in Computer Science and its interdisciplinary applications. Combines academic rigor with practical insights to inspire learning, innovation, and professional growth within the academic community and beyond.

She has the ability to conduct research and feasibility studies in fields of interest of the students. She is having good knowledge of Cloud technology, which can be incorporated in Data science, IOT, AI, Security, Software Engineering and Management domain.

She has authored and co-authored over 50 research papers in international journals and conferences including IEEE, Scopus-SCI, Springer and Elsevier Conference proceeding. She is also a co-author of Ecommerce book. She has presented various papers at international conferences. She served as resource person of many International conferences as well as FDP and SDP. She uses to be part of review committee members of IEEE, Springer conferences. Her name she is having patents and copyrights too. She served as a mentor of various national level hackathon ."

name: Dr. Rajasimha A Makaram
bio: Dr. Rajasimha A Makaram, an Associate Director at JAIN (Deemed-to-be University), specializes in Computer Science Engineering, particularly Software Engineering. He holds a Doctor of Science (D.Sc.) degree from Tumkur University, a Master of Science (MS) degree from Birla Institute of Technology & Science, Pilani, and a Bachelor of Engineering (BE) degree from Bangalore University.

name: Dr. Ajay Kumar Singh
bio:
Dr. Ajay Kumar Singh, is a Professor here. He possesses a diverse educational background and extensive work experience. He taught more than 25 subjects throughout his life. He holds a Bachelor's degree from Kumaon Engineering College, an M.Tech from Sam Higginbottom University of Agriculture Technology and Sciences and a Ph.D. from Jaypee University of Information Technology. He has done a Short-Term Post-PhD program from Thu Dau Mot University in Vietnam.

He has more than 25 years of experience in several colleges / Universities like Raj Kumar Goel Institute of Technology, Ghaziabad, (U.P), Krishna Institute of Engineering Technology, Ghaziabad, (U.P), Meerut Institute of Engineering Technology, Meerut, (U.P), Radha Govind Engineering College, Meerut, (U.P), Sir Padampat Singhania University, Bhatewar, Udaipur, Rajasthan, Jaypee University of Information Technology, Waknaghat, Solan (H.P), Mody University of Science and Technology, Lakshmangarh, Sikar, Rajasthan, Regional Engineering College (Now N.I.T.) Kurukshetra (Haryana), Software Solution Integrated Ltd.

He evaluated Ph.D. theses, guided Ph.D. student and supervised M.Tech students. He actively participates in several international conferences as a session chair.He has published more than 75 research papers, presented his work at conferences in India and abroad and holds many different domain certificates and 5 international patents.

name: Dr.Gowthul Alam M M
bio:
"Dr. Gowthul Alam M M is a Professor in the School of Computer Science and Engineering at JAIN (Deemed-to-be) University. He holds a B.E. degree in Computer Science and Engineering from Government College of Engineering, Tirunelveli, and M.E. and Ph.D. degrees in Computer Science and Engineering from Anna University, Chennai. He also completed M.B.A. degree in Human Resources from Manonmaniam Sundaranar University, Tirunelveli.

He has more than 22 Years of Teaching experience in Self Financial Engineering Colleges. With a strong research background, he has made significant contributions to the field. He has published numerous papers in esteemed journals indexed in SCI and SCOPUS. His research interests lie in Data Mining, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence and IOT.

As a dedicated professional, he actively engages in the academic community and is a member of prestigious organizations such as the Institution of Engineers (IEI), the Indian Society for Technical Education (ISTE) and the International Association of Engineers (IAENG).

name: Dr. Chandrasekar Venkatachalam
bio:
Dr. Chandrasekar Venkatachalam, is a Professor at the JAIN (Deemed-to-be University), specializes in, Artificial Intelligence, Pattern Recognition, Data Science, and Software Engineering. He holds a B.E., M.E., MBA and Ph.D. in Computer Science and Engineering from Anna University.

With over a decade of teaching experience, Dr. Chandrasekar V has 5 patents and a remarkable publication record, including over 40 papers in international journals. He is actively involved as an editor and reviewer for renowned publishing houses. He organizes national workshops and technical events, demonstrating his commitment to knowledge sharing and professional development. Dr. Chandrasekar V is a member of professional organizations such as IEEE, IACSIT, and IAENG. He frequently delivers lectures on research methodology to students and research scholars.

name: Dr.Saravanakumar R
bio:
Dr. SARAVANAKUMAR R holds degrees in Computer Science and Engineering, including a Ph.D. from Anna University, Chennai in 2015 along with a Master's Degree in Computer Science & Engineering from Anna University, Chennai, and a Bachelor's Degree in CSE from Bharathiyar University, Coimbatore. He has 18+ years of experience in teaching and research, and is currently working as a Professor at JAIN (Deemed-to-be University), Bangalore.

He has published over 55 refereed publications in renowned Scopus/WoS and SCIE indexed journals and conferences and authored 4 textbooks. He holds 5 Indian patents and has earned an Innovation Grand patent from the UK Patent Office. Additionally, he serves as a Corresponding Editor for IGI Global Publications, CRC Press, and Bentham Science Publications, and actively reviews for international journals. He is also a member of ACM, IAENG, and CSI, focusing his research on Data Analytics, Big data Analytics, Data Science & Cloud Computing.

His expertise is acknowledged by the academic community, actively contributing as a reviewer, technical committee member, Assessment and Accreditation Process (NBA, NIRF, and NAAC)

name: Dr.Panduranga Rao MV
bio:
"Dr. M. V. Panduranga Rao, obtained his PhD degree in computer science from National Institute of Technology Karnataka, Mangalore, India. He has completed a Master of Technology in computer science and Bachelor of Engineering in Electronics and communication Engineering from Jawaharlal Nehru National College of Engineering Shimoga.

He is currently working as Professor in JAIN (Deemed-to-be University) Bengaluru, India. His research interests are in the field of Real-Time and Embedded Systems, Machine learning - Internet of Things. He has published various Patents, Research papers in journal and conferences across India, also in the IEEE international conference in Okinawa, Japan (visited) 2008.Under his leadership the ISE department was accredited twice by NBA.

Under his leadership the ISE department of JAIN (Deemed-to-be University) was accredited National Board of Accreditation for the duration 2022 to 2025. Also during 2008 to 2011, ISE department of Don Bosco Institute of Technology, Bangalore is accredited.

As HOD of ISE actively participated and contributed in the accreditation of the institution by NAAC with A++ Grade for the duration 2022 – 2028 for ISE department of JAIN (Deemed-to-be University).He has authored two reference books on Linux Internals. He is the Life member of Indian Society for Technical Education and IAENG.

Now from past three years, he has published 12 Indian patents and TWO patents GRANTED for 20 YEARS, three patents are stepping towards grant status.One research scholar under his guidance was awarded a PhD degree. Two more research scholars submitted Thesis. He can be contacted at email: r.panduranga@jainuniversity.ac.in."

name: Dr. Suresh Kallam
bio: Dr. Suresh kallam, a Professor of Computer Science and Engineering(IOT) at JAIN (Deemed-to-be University), obtained his PhD from VIT University and completed a postdoctoral fellowship in Vietnam. He has held significant roles at the university level and specializes in areas such as the Internet of Things, machine learning, and Big Data. Dr. Suresh has published numerous research articles and presented at national and international conferences and journals. Suresh received a grant from AICTE. Previously, he worked as Program Head at Galgotias University, NCR, Delhi, and as a foreign faculty member and visiting faculty member at P.R. China. His contributions include granted and published patents, as well as securing grants for research promotion. Recognized as a dedicated educator, he has received awards such as Best Teacher and Young Faculty in Computer Science and Engineering. Dr. Suresh was also honored as one of the 2000 Outstanding Intellectuals of the 21st Century by the International Biographical Centre.

name: Dr.Devaraj Verma C
bio: Dr. Devaraj Verma C, Working as a Professor in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, FET, Jain(Deemed to be University). He holds a graduation degree in Computer Science and Engineering from SLN college of Engineering, Raichur, Karnataka affiliated to Visvesvarayya Technological University, Belgaum and Masters Degree in Computer Science and Engineering from PDACE Gulbarga, affiliated to VTU. He is NET and KSET qualified professor. He is associated as a life time member of professional bodies like ISTE, IACSIT and IAENG. He is having 23 years of teaching experience. He had obtained his Ph.D degree in the area of artificial intelligence. His PhD work is towards building the Computational model for diversity of Mind. He applied the theory of mind to detect the malicious node using the cognitive model. His area of interest includes cognitive science, image processing, IoT and machine learning in the broad domain of Artificial intelligence. He has published more than 40+ research papers in various national/international conferences and journals. He is the reviewer of the book titled “Artificial Intelligence: Theories and Applications”. It is a 600-odd page book written by Dr. Lavika Goel, 2nd edition, published by Wiley India Pvt. Ltd, July 2019. He is the recognized research supervisor and guiding eight research scholars at Jain(Deemed to be University).

name: Dr.N.Satheesh
bio:
"Dr. N. Satheesh is a distinguished academician and researcher with over 18+ years of experience in the field of computer science. His career is marked by a blend of teaching, research, and professional practice, reflecting his commitment to both organizational and personal growth through technology, skill, innovation, and teamwork.

Dr. Satheesh began his professional journey as a Software Engineer at Maayoke Technology, where he worked from April 2004 to September 2006. His early exposure to software development projects and report generation laid a strong foundation for his future academic endeavors. Transitioning to academia, Dr. Satheesh has served in various esteemed institutions, holding significant positions that have shaped his illustrious career.

As a Professor and Head of the M. Tech (AI & DS) program at St. Martin’s Engineering College, Hyderabad, from May 2019 to February 2023, Dr. Satheesh played a pivotal role in fostering an environment of innovation and excellence. His leadership extended to his tenure at Dr. Nallini Institute of Engineering & Technology as Associate Professor and Vice Principal, where he significantly contributed to academic administration and accreditation processes.

Currently, Dr. Satheesh is a Professor in the Department of Artificial Intelligence at SCE, Jain Global Campus, JAIN (Deemed-to-be University), Bangalore. His academic journey also includes roles as an Assistant Professor and Head of the CSE Department at Greentech College of Engineering for Women, and as an Associate Professor at Challapathi Institute of Engineering & Technology. His teaching portfolio is extensive, covering subjects such as Object-Oriented Programming, Java, Computer Networks, and Software Testing, among others.

Dr. Satheesh's research interests are diverse and impactful. He has published extensively in high-impact journals and holds multiple patents. His work includes significant contributions to the fields of IoT, machine learning, network security, and artificial intelligence. Notable publications include articles in journals such as IEEE Access and the International Journal of Intelligent Systems and Applications in Engineering.

In addition to his research, Dr. Satheesh has actively participated in numerous workshops and conferences, both as a presenter and organizer. His involvement in events related to web technology, MATLAB, neural networks, and machine learning underscores his dedication to continuous learning and professional development.

Dr. Satheesh’s technical expertise is complemented by his proficiency in various programming languages, web design technologies, and database management systems. He is skilled in C, C++, Java, Python, VB.NET, ASP.NET, HTML, PHP, Oracle 9i, and SQL Server 2005, among others.

Beyond his professional achievements, Dr. Satheesh is deeply committed to mentoring and guiding students. His efforts as a placement coordinator and his involvement in accreditation activities have significantly contributed to the academic growth and institutional development of the colleges he has been associated with.Dr. N. Satheesh's career is a testament to his dedication to the field of computer science, marked by his innovative teaching methods, impactful research, and unwavering commitment to academic excellence."

name: Dr. Shajahan Basheer
bio:
"Dr. Shajahan Basheer is a renowned Professor in the School of Computer Science and Engineering at JAIN (Deemed-to-be University), where he leads the CSE - Cyber Physical System programme. He holds a PhD in Information and Communication Engineering from Anna University and a ME CSE degree from Annamalai University. With 20 years of teaching and 6 years of research experience. He has published research papers in prestigious journals and conferences, written textbook chapters, and served as a reviewer and session chair for international journal and conferences. His experience includes supervising Ph.D. research scholars, particularly in wireless networks, image processing, and computational intelligence.

He actively participates in curriculum development and academic initiatives as a member of the Board of Studies. He has organized National Conferences, Seminars, and Workshops. His research focuses on creating a security framework for wireless networks, computational intelligence, and cybersecurity. He is an IEEE Senior Member and a member of notable organisations such ISTE, CSTA, and IAENG.

name: Dr. J Somasekar
bio: Dr. J. Somasekar received a Ph.D. degree in Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) from JNTUA, Andhra Pradesh, and an M.Tech. degree from the National Institute of Technology Karnataka (NITK), Surathkal. . He is currently serving as a Professor and head of the CSE (AI-Driven DevOps) program at JAIN (Deemed-to-be University), Bangalore. He also holds positions as a Post-doctoral Researcher at the University of South Florida, USA, and a Research Fellow at INTI International University, Malaysia. As a resource person, he has delivered 198 Technical Talks (Invited Talks) for various events sponsored by AICTE/ISTE/DST/UGC/CSIR, in 13 states within the country and in international events. With over 18 years of experience, he has published more than 30 research articles in leading journals, along with three international textbook chapters and authored three textbooks. He served as a visiting professor for the Data Science program at Kannur University, Kerala. He has been awarded the 'Innovative Collaborative Researcher' award in Medical Imaging for his work with Dr. Ching-Hao Lai, Taiwan. He has also received the Best Outstanding Speaker award and multiple Best Paper awards at conferences. His research interests include Machine Learning, Image Processing, Data Science, and ML for Cybersecurity.

name: Dr.A Suresh Kumar
bio: Dr. Suresh Kumar Arumugam, a distinguished professor in the School of Computer Science and Engineering at Jain (Deemed to be University), Bengaluru, holds a Ph.D. in Computer Science and Engineering from Anna University, Chennai. With over 18 years of teaching and research experience, he specializes in Wireless Sensor Networks, Internet of Things, Artificial Intelligence, and Machine Learning. Dr. Arumugam has an impressive publication record, including 20 SCI articles, over 50 Scopus articles, and 7 Indian patents, along with an Innovation Grand patent from Germany. As a senior member of IEEE, IAENG, and CSI societies, he actively participates in peer-reviewing for international journals. He has also edited multiple books on topics ranging from security to healthcare analytics, published by renowned publishers like CRC Press, IGI Global, and Bentham Science. Additionally, he has been recognized as an NAAC assessor and IEEE India Council Provisional Mentor.

name: Dr. A. Rajesh
bio: Dr. A. Rajesh completed his B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering from Government College of Engineering, Salem, in 1997, and his M.E. in Computer Science and Engineering from Sathyabama Institute of Science and Technology in 2005. He earned his PhD in Computer Science and Engineering from Dr. MGR Educational and Research Institute in 2011. Beginning his career as a Commissioning cum Service Engineer in 1997, he later joined C. Abdul Hakeem College of Engineering and Technology as a Lecturer in 2000 and became Head of the CSE department in 2006. He was instrumental in the department's accreditation by the NBA and NAAC. He served as Principal of the institution from 2015 to 2020. Since 2020, he has been with JAIN (Deemed-to-be University), Bangalore, as Professor, Program Coordinator, Deputy HOD, and currently Program Head of CSE AI. He has published 71 research papers, 9 books, and 5 patents, and has produced 10 Doctorates under his guidance. His research interests include AI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Data Mining.

name: Dr. Babasaheb Satpute
bio:
"Dr. Babasaheb Sambhajirao Satpute is an Professor in the School of Computer Science and Engineering at JAIN (Deemed-to-be) University. He earned his Bachelor's degree in Information Technology (B.E.), followed by a Master's degree (M.Tech-IIITA) and a Ph.D. in Computer Engineering.

With a rich teaching career spanning 20 years, Dr. Satpute specializes in Machine Learning and Deep Learning. He has a notable record of achievements, including 3 patents and over 40 research papers published in esteemed international journals and conferences. Additionally, he is an accomplished author with 7 book chapters to his credit.

Dr. Satpute is dedicated to sharing his expertise widely. He creates educational content on various online platforms, notably through his popular YouTube channel 'Satpute Academy'. His Udemy course on Deep Learning has garnered global acclaim, contributing significantly to the field's education. Furthermore, his instructional video on navigating the process of filing Indian patents has been particularly beneficial to professionals and students alike.

Beyond his academic roles, Dr. Satpute has excelled in academic examinations, having qualified for the GATE examination five times. He also serves as an Adjunct Professor at BITS Pilani, further enriching his contributions to academia."

name: Dr. T.V. Raman
bio:
Dr. T.V. Raman is a professor in the School of Computer Science and Engineering at JAIN (Deemed-to-be University) And is an editor for a text book whose title is Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning for the Smart Community: Concepts and Applications. CRC Press USA, he published an article in the Information Fusion journal with impact factor 18, and the title of the article is Adversarial Deep Learning-based Dampster-Shafer Data Fusion Model for Intelligent Transportation Systems. He is also a reviewer for the IET Communication Journal and the author of several text books published by SIP International. Book Title: International Business, February 2022. ISBN 9789394002562, Publisher: SIP International

Book Title: Computer Architecture, March 2022. ISBN 9789394002302, Publisher: SIP International, he presented a research paper at the 6th international multi-topic conference on engineering and science (IMCES) conducted by YARSI University Indonesia in July 2023.

Committed to advanced research in the field of computer science and engineering. His research interests span across areas, including cloud computing, machine learning, the Internet of Things (IoT), software engineering, and computer system architecture. These interests reflect his engagement with cutting-edge technologies and emerging trends in the field.

name: Dr. Sonal Sharma
bio:
Dr. Sonal Sharma, having 16+ years of experience in teaching Computer Science subjects.Currently, she is working as Associate Professor of Computer Science and Engineering with Cloud Technology in Mobile Application and Information Security, in JAIN (Deemed-to-be University). Her research area is Artificial Intelligence, Cloud Computing, Cyber Security, and Nature Inspired Algorithm.

She published more than 25 papers in Journals, International Conferences. She got so many awards for her research activities including Asian Award for Young Professor 2023, India Prime Icon 2022 and Best Academician from IFST 2020. She published her 3 books. She is a blogger for Hindi Poetries also. She trained the students of both UG, and PG, and Scholars in Cloud Security, Cloud Computing, and Cyber Security domains. She has presented and published research papers in various Conferences and Journals of National and International repute.

name: Dr. Ananthoju Vijay Kumar
bio: Dr Ananthoju Vijay Kumar is working as an Associate Professor in CTIS(Cloud Technology and Information Security) and CTMA( Cloud Technology and Mobile Application) since 2020 on words to till date. He has published 53 articles in the National and International Journals. His area of specialization is Cloud Security, Information Security, Cyber Security and Data mining. He has received Dr APJ Abdul Kalam Life Time Achievement National Award from International Institute of Socio Economic Reforms, Bangalore, Karnataka, India in 2022. He has 18 years of teaching experience.

name: Dr. Vikram Neerugatti
bio:
"Dr. Vikram Neerugatti, an Associate Professor at JAIN (Deemed-to-be University)'s School of Computer Science and Engineering, brings over 14 years of teaching experience and a strong academic background. With a Ph.D. in Computer Science and Engineering from Sri Venkateshwara University, he holds Master's degrees in Computer Science and Engineering and Computing from reputable universities in India and the UK. His research areas encompass the Internet of Things, Augmented Reality and Virtual Reality, Fog/Edge Computing, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, and Data Science.

Dr. Neerugatti boasts an impressive research track record, including 21 patents (including 3 granted), four published textbooks, and over 30 publications in international conferences and SCI/Scopus-indexed journals. His work has earned him six best research paper awards and prestigious fellowships.

Actively involved in professional organizations like IEEE and ACM, Dr. Neerugatti contributes to workshops, conferences, and technical events. He serves as a resource person for workshops on IoT, Fog Computing, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, and Big Data Analytics.

His commitment to research excellence is evident through securing a grant for the Development of AR/VR LAB and submitting research proposals to esteemed funding agencies. Dr. Neerugatti is dedicated to innovation and actively pursues IP awards and DST Inspire awards."

name: Dr. D Ramya Dorai
bio:
"Dr. RAMYA DORAI is serving as an Associate Professor in the Department of Computer Science & Engineering, JAIN (Deemed-to-be University), Kanakapura, Karnataka, India

She possesses Immense background in teaching, research with 17 years of experience. Dr. D. Ramya Dorai Education includes BE-ISE, ME-CSE, and Ph.D. in Information and Communication Engineering, from Anna University, Chennai. Also holds a MBA degree in Human Resource Management from Annamalai University. Her research interests include mobile ad hoc networks (MANETs) and wireless sensor networks (WSNs). She has authored research papers in renowned journals including Scopus indexed journals. She is a member of ISTE , IE(I) chapter"

name: Dr. Jeralad Nirmmal Kumar S
bio: I had completed my Doctor of Philosophy (CSE) at Anna University in 2021, my MTech (CSE) at Veltech Technical University in 2011, and my B.E (CSE) at Anna University in 2005. I have 14 years of experience with 12 years of teaching and 2 years in Industry. I completed my OBE certification in Swayam NPTEL, and Wipro 10 X certification for Teaching-Learning Process. I have published 11 SCI / Scopus, 4 National conferences, 4 Scopus Book chapters, and 1 Scopus Edited books one is published in IGI Global , 5 Indian patents, 1 International Patent (German), and 1 International Copyright (Canadian). My area of Interest is cloud computing, AI, and ML. I am a life member of the Indian Society for Technical Education (ISTE) and a member of IEEE and professional bodies like IFERP, IEANG, and IRED.

name: Dr. Giddaluri Nagendra Babu
bio: Dr. Giddaluri Nagendra Babu, with over 17 years of experience, is a distinguished educator and researcher in Computer Science and Engineering. He holds a B.Tech, M.Tech, and Ph.D. in the field. Known for his effective teaching pedagogy and curriculum development, Dr. Babu is a certified Oracle Database SQL Expert. He has made significant contributions to academia through the publication of numerous research articles in esteemed journals and presentations at international conferences, particularly in the areas of Network Security and Wireless Sensor Networks. He has also published two patents and authored a book and book chapters. His expertise is frequently sought after for guest lectures at reputed institutions.Beyond research, Dr. Babu actively participates in accreditation processes and serves on various Boards of Studies. He has been an editorial member for journals and a reviewer for international conferences, contributing to the advancement of academic discourse. Dr. Babu is a member of several professional associations, including ISTE, IAENG, and IAEPT. Dr. Babu's comprehensive expertise and dedication to both teaching and research make him a valuable asset to the academic community.

name: Dr. Sankar K
bio:
"Dr. Sankar. K is working as an Associate Professor in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering (AIML) of Jain Deemed to be University, Bengaluru. He has more than 19 years of experience in teaching.

He completed his Ph.D. at Anna University, Chennai in 2020. He also completed M. Tech from SRM University and B.E. from Madras University. He has excellent publications across reputed, peer-reviewed International and National journals and Conferences. He also filed various International Patents.

He is also a member of professional Bodies like ISTE, CSI, IAENG, etc., He has guided more than 20 UG & PG student projects across various areas of computer science.

His Research Interests include Data Mining, Image Processing and Image Retrieval, Optical Character Recognition, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Computer vision, and Data Science."

name: Dr. Sugumar R
bio: Dr. R. Sugumar is a distinguished professional with over 17 years of experience in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science Applications, Big Data, Software Engineering, Cloud Computing, and Cyber Security. He completed his Ph.D., from SCSVMV University, Kanchipuram, Tamilnadu, in 2022. He has made significant contributions to numerous reputed and indexed international journals, showcasing his innovative research. He has successfully secured several research project schemes and has been a key organizer of national-level events, including Faculty Development Programs (FDPs), seminars, guest lectures, and workshops. As an avid learner, He holds a professional certification in Blockchain programming from IIT-Kanpur. His dedication to continuous learning and advancement in technology is evident in his work. Additionally, he has authored numerous books under various publications, contributing to education and knowledge dissemination. His expertise, leadership, and commitment to his field make him an inspiring figure in the academic and professional communities.

name: Dr. Senthil Kumar R
bio: Dr. Senthil Kumar has Completed PhD in faculty of Computer Science and Engineering, who is having rich experience in teaching and research. Over 18 years teaching experience, and coordinated with industry collaborated programs such as Oracle workforce development program, Infosys Campus Connect program, Wipro Mission 10X and AICTE funded training programs for various certifications. He has published his research work in various National and International journals like Web of Science, Scopus Indexed Journal and IEEE Explore. Published various patents for his research work and organized various national level Faculty development programs, Workshops, Conference and Seminar.

name: Dr. Manujakshi B C
bio:
Dr. Manujakshi B C is an Associate Professor at the School of Computer Science and Engineering at JAIN (Deemed-to-be University). She earned her Doctor of Philosophy in Computer Science and Engineering from RVCE under VTU. She holds a Master of Technology degree in Computer Science and Engineering from UBDT College of Engineering, Davanagere, under Kuvempu University. Her Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science and Engineering is from SJM Institute of Technology under VTU.

Her research primarily centres on Data Analytics, and she has a notable publication record, with approximately 15 research articles featured in esteemed journals and conferences.

Dr. Renukadevi's dedication to advancing knowledge in her field is further evidenced by her receipt of a grant of Rs 40,000 from the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR). In her role as a mentor, Dr. P.Renukadevi has provided guidance to numerous Master's and undergraduate theses, contributing to the academic development of her students. She has also made significant contributions to education by publishing four patterns and completing 6 NPTEL courses. Notably, her commitment and excellence in mentoring have been acknowledged with an appreciation certificate"

name: Mrs. Sincy John
bio:
Sincy John is an Assistant Professor in the School of Computer Science and Engineering at JAIN (Deemed-to-be University), where she specializes in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. Her journey into the realm of computer science began with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and Engineering from the College of Engineering, Vadakara. Eager to delve deeper into the intricacies of her field, she pursued a Master's degree from Karunya University, Coimbatore, further honing her expertise.

With a passion for research, Sincy has made significant contributions to her field, with seven research papers published in esteemed Scopus indexed journals. She has also presented her work at various international conferences, showcasing her commitment to advancing knowledge in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.

Combining her academic pursuits with practical experience, Sincy has accumulated three years of teaching experience, where she imparts her knowledge and expertise to the next generation of computer scientists and engineers. Currently, she is embarking on her Ph.D. journey at Christ University, focusing her research on the exciting and evolving fields of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.

name: Dr. Archana Sasi
bio: Dr. Archana Sasi received her B.Tech and M.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering and Computer and Information Science from College of Engineering Cherthala in 2012 and 2014 respectively. She received her Ph.D. degree in Computer Science Engineering from Presidency University, Bangalore. She worked as Lecturer in Govt. Polytechnic College, Kaduthuruthy, Kerala from November 2014 to October 2015. She worked in Presidency University, Bangalore from July 2018 to January 2023. She is currently working as Assistant Professor in Computer Science and Engineering Department at JAIN (Deemed-to-be University) Bangalore, Karnataka. She received best paper award in the International Conference on Computing System and its Application organized by Acharya Institute of Technology, Bangalore. She published many research papers in SCIE, Scopus indexed Journals. She has received certification in AWS Solution Architect Associate. Her research areas includes Supply Chain Management, Machine Learning and Internet of things.

name: Dr. Shivam Swarup
bio: Mr. Shivam Swarup has over 5 years of experience in Academic field, where he has worked in various professional roles and capacities. He has showcased excellent aptitude in planning & organizing day-to-day research activities and resolve procedural problems as appropriate to the timely completion of research objectives. Apart from that he also has over 5 years’ experience in IT services sector. He has achieved a ranking within the top 5 percentile of researchers in Technology based Education according to UGC-NET and published multiple high-impact factor journal articles including Applied Sciences (Basel) and Sustainability etc. He has also been editor of journals such as IEEE Transactions on Engineering Management. His Research Interests include: • Machine Learning and Deep Learning models, such as ARIMA, LSTM, STL-LSTM, and XGBoost • AI/ML-based programming languages, including Python (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Matplotlib), RStudio • Iterative Software Development Life Cycle Process as per RUP (Rational Unified Process), Six Sigma Methodologies, and various tools, including all Rational Tools.

name: Mrs.Sahana Shetty
bio: Im Sahana Shetty, and I work for the Department of CSE at the moment (AI and ML and Cyber Security). From 2017 to 2022, I coordinated placements for the Department of CSE (Upto March 2022). I served as a mentor for the Enigma club, which was formed by me and four other students in 2019. I received my B.E. from Sahyadri College of Management and Technology in 2012, and my M.Tech. in computer science and engineering from St. Joseph Engineering College and Management in 2015. Later, I held a position as an Assistant Professor in the Computer Science and Engineering Department at Alvas College of Engineering and Management, Managlore. I was placement coordinator for the department of information science and engineering, as well as a club coordinator named Shristi for 2 years. For a year, I worked as a teacher trainer for Cambridge Business English at Alvas college. I worked as an exam coordinator and Internship coordinator for 2 years. I'm currently pursuing my PhD at JAIN (Deemed-to-be University) and my research area is on Deep Learning and big data analytics. I have presented my paper in various conferences and journal.

name: Ms. Shaik Dilchashmi
bio:
Shaik Dilchashmi holds a Master of Technology (M.Tech) in Computer Science and Engineering from Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University. Her academic journey has been dedicated to applying advanced technologies, focusing on Artificial Intelligence (AI) and web development. She has gained extensive experience through projects involving web technologies, establishing a strong foundation in technical proficiency.

Her notable research includes a project titled "A Comparison of Artificial Intelligence and Deep Learning Methods: Image-Based Plant Disease Detection," where she explored the intersection of AI and deep learning to address real-world challenges in agriculture. This work deepened her expertise in machine learning algorithms and their practical applications.

In addition to her academic pursuits, she has contributed to the scientific community by publishing papers on image classification in esteemed international journals. Her portfolio also includes developing multiple machine learning-based projects, further enhancing her knowledge in this dynamic field. With a strong passion for AI and web development, Shaik Dilchashmi is committed to advancing innovative solutions that integrate these two domains.

name: Dr. M John Basha
bio:
"Dr. M. John Basha is a distinguished academic and researcher with a robust background in Computer Science and Engineering. He earned his Ph.D. in Computer Science and Engineering from the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at Bharath Institute of Higher Education and Research (BIHER) in Chennai, India. Dr. Basha holds a B.Tech degree in Information Technology from Anna University, Chennai, and an M.E degree in Computer Science and Engineering from Anna University of Technology, Trichy.

With 14 years of teaching and research experience, Dr. Basha has made significant contributions to the field. He has served as a Professor and Head of the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at PTR College of Engineering and Technology, Madurai. His academic journey includes the publication of 35 papers in international journals and the presentation of his work at 20 conferences. Dr. Basha has actively participated in numerous seminars and workshops, enhancing his knowledge and expertise.

Currently, Dr. John Basha is an Assistant Professor of Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science) at JAIN (Deemed-to-be University) in Bangalore. His research interests are focused on Machine Learning, Data Mining, and Database Systems, areas in which he continues to contribute through both teaching and research."

name: Dr. Santhosh S
bio: Dr. Santhosh S is currently working as an Assistant Professor and Program Head, Computer Engineering (Software Engineering), School of Computer Science and Engineering, Faculty of Engineering and Technology, JAIN (Deemed-to-be University). Completed his Ph.D in Computer Science and Engineering from Jain Deemed-to-be University, Bangalore, M.Tech (CSE) from Visvesvaraya Technological University, Karnataka and B.E (CSE) from Anna University, Tamilnadu. He has overall 14 years of experience in teaching, administration, and industry. He has published five articles in peer-reviewed journals, presented five articles at international conferences, one book, one book chapter, and four papers at national conferences. Dr. Santhosh S research interests revolve around cutting-edge areas such as Cloud Computing, Software Engineering, and Computer Networks.

name: Mr. N.Shantha kumar
bio: N. Shantha Kumar, Assistant Professor, Department of CSE-Software engineering. He is a also a Research Scholar, Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Visvesvaraya Technological University, Belgaum, Karnataka. He received his B.E in Computer Science and Engineering from PESIT, Bangalore and M.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering from SJBIT, Bangalore. He has more than 15 years teaching experience in various reputed Engineering Colleges and universities. He has authored many research papers in National reputed journals and conferences. His area of interest includes Computer networks, Data Communications, Web Technologies , Research methodologies, Data science, Database management systems, Software Engineering, Information Security, Entrepreneurship and management. His current research work includes Security in Wireless Sensor Networks.

name: Mr. Karthikeyan.S
bio: Prof. Karthikeyan S is an assistant professor at the School of Computer Science & Engineering, specializing in software engineering. He holds a Master's in Computer Science and Engineering from Anna University, Tamil Nadu, India. He is pursuing his Ph.D. in Computer Science and Engineering from Galgotias University, NCR Delhi, India. His research focuses on cutting-edge areas such as Deep Learning and IoT Security. Throughout his academic journey, he has actively engaged in various research projects and significantly contributed to the field. His work has been recognized by publishing book chapters and research papers in esteemed conferences and international journals, and he has published patent on cloud security and editorial books on the Internet of Things. He has completed NPTEL on TALE and has been developing courses on MOOC for web technologies. He actively learns by attending FDP seminars and webinars on emerging trends. With his profound interest in Deep learning and IoT Security, he continues to explore and develop innovative approaches to enhance the security and efficiency of these technologies.

name: Mr. Basavaraju D R
bio:
Basavaraju D R is an Assistant Professor in the School of Computer Science and Engineering. He holds an M.Tech degree from R V College of Engineering, specializing in Radio Frequency and Microwave Engineering. His exceptional academic performance earned him the Gold Medal (1st Rank) in M.Tech from VTU, awarded by the esteemed Shri Vajubhai Vala, Ex-Governor of the Government of Karnataka.

Prior to his academic career, Basavaraju D R gained valuable industry experience as a project trainee at TATA POWER SED. During his tenure, he actively contributed to the design and development of LTE Base station for defense applications, showcasing his practical skills and industry exposure.

Basavaraju D R's research contributions have been recognized in both national and international conferences. He has published Five research papers in prestigious IEEE International conferences and Two in a National conference, highlighting his dedication to advancing knowledge in his field. He has also awarded with the Best Paper Award in the IEEE 3rd International Conference on MPCIT-2020 for the Paper Titled " REALIZATION OF SEMICIRCULAR 2 WAY OPTIMAL POWER DIVIDER FOR GNSS".

name: Dr. P Srinivasa Rao
bio:
"Dr. Srinivasa Rao is an Assistant Professor at the Jain Deemed to be University. He has a B.Tech. and M.Tech. degrees and a Ph.D. in data mining. Dr. Srinivasa Rao has 14 years of teaching experience, which has helped him to refine his knowledge in the subject. With the publication of Eight papers in prestigious national and international journals and conferences, he has significantly advanced research. conferences, workshops, refresher courses, student festivals, and technical symposiums were organized by him.

Dr. Srinivasa Rao actively participates in a number of national training programs, workshops, symposiums, seminars, conferences, and conferences to further further her professional development."

name: Prof Vasanth Ravi
bio:
Prof. Vasanth Ravi is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, currently pursuing his Ph.D. at SRM Institute of Science and Technology with a focus on Deep Learning and Sustainable Computing. He holds a Master of Engineering in Computer Science and Engineering and a Bachelor of Technology in Information Technology from an Anna University-affiliated institution in Chennai. With extensive teaching experience, he has mentored students, contributed to curriculum development, and taught courses such as Data Structures, Python Programming, and Deep Learning.

His research interests include Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, with publications in reputed journals and patents for innovative solutions, including an IoT-driven water quality monitoring system and a Virtual Fencing framework for animal sustainability.

name: Prof. C.Vairavel
bio:
C. Vairavel is an Assistant Professor in the School of Computer Science and Engineering at JAIN. With over 15 years of teaching experience, he comes with a huge passion to teach.

Mr. Vairavel holds a Master's degree (M.E.-CSE) from Anna University, Chennai, and a Bachelor's degree (B.Tech-IT) from the same institution. Currently, he is pursuing his Ph.D. in Computer Science and Engineering from Anna University, Chennai.

His research interests encompass a wide range of areas, including Information Security, Big Data Privacy, Computer Network Security, IoT, and Big Data Analytics. Mr. Vairavel has made significant contributions to academia and has authored and co-authored more than 5 research papers published in reputed international journals (SCI/SCIE/ESCI/Scopus) and conferences.

name: Dr. Pratheepkumar P
bio:
Dr. Pratheep Kumar P is an Assistant Professor and Head of the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, at JAIN (Deemed-to-be University), with an extensive academic experience of 23 years and 9 years in the industry. He combines a strong commitment to teaching and mentoring with practical insights from his industry background, which has refined his ability to apply cutting-edge technologies to real-world challenges.

Dr. Kumar's research focuses on Artificial Intelligence, where he explores its potential in solving complex problems and driving innovation. This unique synergy between academia, industry, and research allows him to effectively bridge the gap between theory and practice, fostering a rich learning environment for his students.

name: Dr. Arshey M
bio:
Dr. Arshey M is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, at JAIN (Deemed-to-be University). She holds a Ph.D. in Cyber Security using Deep Learning and Artificial Intelligence. She earned her M.E. and B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering from Anna University.

With 18 years of experience in teaching, administration, and industry, Dr. Arshey is a dedicated educator and AI enthusiast. She has published articles in peer-reviewed journals, including those indexed in SCI and Scopus.

Dr. Arshey M is deeply committed to her students, actively mentoring undergraduate and postgraduate students by guiding academic projects and coordinating various technical events, conferences, and competitions to enhance their learning experience and professional development. Her research interests encompass Cyber Security, Deep Learning, and Artificial Intelligence.

name: Ninitha Mary
bio:
Ninitha Mary Antonina N.M. is an accomplished Assistant Professor in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at JAIN (Deemed-to-be University). With over 12 years of dedicated teaching experience, she brings a profound depth of knowledge and expertise to her role. Her academic journey includes a Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) and a Master of Technology (M.Tech), along with an ongoing Ph.D. in Computer Science and Engineering from the esteemed National Institute of Technology, Calicut.

Her areas of interest are diverse and compelling, encompassing Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Quantum Computing. Ninitha is passionate about creating a stimulating academic environment that not only inspires students to delve into these complex subjects but also equips them with practical skills to excel in the rapidly evolving tech landscape.

name: Govind S Menon
bio: Govind S Menon is an Assistant Professor of Mechanical Engineering at JAIN (Deemed-to-be University) in the School of Computer Science and Engineering. He is a Mechanical and Energy Engineer and an MBA Graduate. He is Pursuing PhD in Mechanical Engineering from CUSAT- Kochi. With an exceptional experience of 11 years in teaching and 1.5 years of Industrial Experience, he adds great value to the institute. His areas of Research interest include Mechanical Engineering, Renewable Energy,Energy Management, Logistics and Supply chain Management.

name: Dr. Lidiya T V
bio:
Dr. Lidiya T V is an Assistant Professor in Department of Physics & Electronics, JAIN (Deemed-to-be University). She has completed Ph.D in Applied Physics from Cochin University of Science and Technology, Cochin in 2023. Her research interests encompass areas, Nanofabrication technologies, Atomic layer deposition, Vacuum technologies, Semiconducting thin films, Optoelectronic device fabrication etc.

She has published papers and book chapter in Scopus indexed/ UGC approved journals, along with papers presented in international conferences. In addition to a year of teaching experience, she worked as a project fellow of the KSCSTE project at the Department of Instrumentation, Cochin University of Science and Technology, Cochin during 2012 - 2015.

name: Mr. Narasimhayya B E
bio: Prof. Narasimhayya B E is an Assistant Professor at JAIN (Deemed-to-be University), currently pursuing his Ph.D. in “Green IoT”. He completed his M.Tech in Computer Science and B.E in Information Science from Visveswaraya Technological University, Belagum, Karnataka. He has one-year industry experience as a Web Developer and 12 years of teaching experience. His area of research revolves around Green IoT, Natural Language Processing, Machine Learning. He was trained at Google for the basics and Advanced Mobile Application Development using Android, also handled couple of workshops on Android Development.He is the club coordinator and inspires students to work on projects and internships. His research and industry experience will help students to build industry ready prospectus.

name: Ms. Sunena Rose MV
bio:
Prof. Sunena Rose specializes in Computer Science and Engineering, holding an M.Tech degree in the same field. Currently, she is pursuing a Ph.D. in Artificial Intelligence at JAIN (Deemed-to-be University). With a combined experience of 4 years in research and academics, she has made significant contributions to the field.

During her professional journey, Prof. Sunena Rose served as a Project Assistant at the Council for Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR), Bangalore.She actively participated in VANET and DARTNET-based projects, collaborating with industry partners to achieve research objectives.

Her areas of expertise encompass Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Cyber Security. With a keen interest in these domains, Prof. Sunena Rose constantly strives to stay at the forefront of technological advancements and emerging trends.

name: Dr. Harinee S
bio: Dr Harinee S is currently working as Assistant Professor, focusing on security for IoT. She has completed her Integrated PhD in Computer Science and Engineering from VIT, Vellore, specializing in security for IoT devices. Prior to that, she has earned her Bachelor’s degree in Technology in Computer Science Engineering from Sri Manakula Vinayagar Engineering College, Pondicherry University. Her research interests span across several cutting-edge domains such as healthcare, cloud computing, information security, robotics, and technology innovation. She is particularly fascinated by how advancements in technology can revolutionize healthcare delivery systems, enhance cybersecurity measures, and drive innovations in robotics and cloud-based solutions. Her aim is to leverage her expertise in these areas to contribute significantly for the development of innovative technologies that address real-world challenges. She has published 2 international journals, 3 book chapters and 5 international conference papers.

name: Dr. C Mahiba
bio:
"Dr. C. Mahiba, an Assistant Professor at JAIN (Deemed-to-be University), School of Computer Science and Engineering, has 11 years of teaching experience and a Ph.D. from Anna University.She has completed B.E. from St. Xavier’s Catholic College of Engineering and M.E. degree from the Government College of Engineering, Tirunelveli, she has showcased her dedication to higher education and research.

Her scholarly contributions to academia include numerous research articles published in renowned international and national journals.Dr. C. Mahiba's passion for education and dynamic learning is highlighted in her role at JAIN (Deemed-to-be University), where she also organises workshops and events for students. Her research interests include Image Classification, Image Retrieval, Machine Learning, and Artificial Intelligence.She is an active member of professional bodies in the engineering discipline and serves as an board member for reputed journals. Additionally, she has filed several patents."

name: Dr. Janarthanan Sekar
bio: Dr. Janarthanan Sekar., working as an Assistant Professor in Faculty of Engineering and Technology under the Department of Computer Engineering—Software Engineering, JAIN (Deemed-to-be University), Karnataka, India. His areas of specialization are image processing, remote sensing, and deep learning. He completed Ph.D. in Computer Science and Engineering at Galgotias University, Uttar Pradesh, and also completed his bachelor's and master's degrees in the Computer Science and Engineering core stream from Anna University, Chennai more than 12 years’ experience in both industry and academic institutions. He has been published in many international and national conferences, journals, and patents and also successfully completed "Artificial Intelligence and Deep Learning" workshop training for image classification with digits and object detection with digits NVIDIA. also served as a mentor in the AICTE-organized SMART India Hackathon, guiding students through various projects involving image processing, deep learning, and smart voice assistants. And having MOOC certifications in NPTEL/SWAYAM for the courses Software Testing, OBE, TALE, Python for Data science. The best outcome was being invited as a resource person for webinars, workshops, seminars, and session chairs, as well as a keynote speaker for several conferences in various organizations.

name: Dr. Priya N
bio: Dr. Priya N is an esteemed cybersecurity and blockchain researcher with a strong academic background. She has significantly contributed to various domains including blockchain, Hyperledger, cybersecurity, digital forensics, and Identity Access Management. Priya has authored/co-authored numerous articles published in reputable cybersecurity and blockchain journals. Her research interests span blockchain technology, cyber forensics, web application security, and malware analysis within educational institutions. Apart from journal publications, Priya has presented several papers at national and international conferences, showcasing her expertise in blockchain methodology for identity management and document verification systems. She further explores blockchain applications in smart industry management and crowdfunding solutions. Priya's innovative research in cyber forensics demonstrates her profound understanding and utilization of cutting-edge technologies in the field of computer science and cyber security
